notes.title: Bug Fixes from Drone Update.
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes.


 
 -Flashlight Switches off when shifting between modes.
 -Can no longer puke or get radiated in Drone Mode.
 -There is no longer any air drag when in Drone Mode.
 -Pressurizers now save their stored air properly.
 -Hand shields should now block projectiles properly.

notes.title: Update # 1.2 Local co-op with helper Drone!
notes.notes:
We're finally back with a new exciting update! 

We added a drone that can be played with a keyboard and mouse or in VR.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30571339/e26371fa39df5bda6cd2af8db8e8aca4e0a7d3a7.gif

New stuff:
 

 Helper Drone. Can be remote-controlled by the VR player, to repair the ship if you're out exploring or the like.
 Helper Drone can also be controlled by a second player from the PC.

The Helper Drone can salvage, repair, shoot and "grab objects". and interact with most UI panels.



Fixes & tweaks: 

 

 Fixed Issue where the radiation shower would not update UI.
  Fixed issue where the "Titan" would move through your base.
  Fixed issue where the "Hand Shield" would be dropped when you grabbed something (yikes).
  Tweaked non-symmetrical displaying of gun ammo.
  Fixed Issue where a spaceship was a missing collision.
  Doors Auto-Open toggle now require a "hold press".
  You must now confirm in UI when you want to salvage a part of your base.




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30571339/f9712835f79f91fda51096aa40b680515eaa2e1c.png 
Join DISCORD here!


Thanks for playing! 

HAVE FUN!

notes.title: Update # 1.1.9 - Finally, long awaited fixes and improvements.
notes.notes:
Finally, an update is here. 

We're so happy to say that we managed to fix a bunch of things and even add some new stuff! 

New stuff :

 Crafting will be using both the suit inventory and the storage units in the ship. 
 Added Gravity gun mod
 Added More tutorials
 Added help in the main base computer (description of most of the stuff in-game) 
 Added more lore stuff in the main computer archive. 
 Added quest system
 Added countdown for comets and incoming hazards if you have the map built.


Tweaks

 Improved Radiation feedback. 
 Gates automatic toggle is now saved 
 tweaked wall plant pot collider
 Debris despawning better
 increased the minimum salvage time
 Changed the handheld shield to be placed on the wrist and from there be toggled on/ off. 


Fixes

 Fixed Oxygen leak on hologates
 Fixed Index controller fixes
 Fixed Suit radiation bugs 
 Fixed "Transfer all" button on nano storage. 
 Fixed music player UI 
 Fixed Some quests not triggering correctly
 Fixed the smooth turning setting.
 Fixed an issue with gun mods not saving correctly
 Fixed an issue where outside objects could be placed on the inside. 
 Seed labels beeing saved on exit and return.
 Fixed fruit plant UI not displaying correctly



Thanks for playing and thanks for the patience. 


We're also still active on the  STAR SHELTER DISCORD if you wanna have a chat

HAVE FUN!

notes.title: Upcoming Update!
notes.notes:
Finally, an update is in the works. 


We just wanted to let you know that we have an update that will be launched at the end of the next month, with fixes, tweaks and some New stuff. 


New stuff coming up:

 Crafting will be using both the suit inventory and the storage units in the ship. 
 Added Gravity gun mod
 More tutorials 
 Added help in the main base computer (description of most of the stuff in-game) 
 more lore stuff in the main computer archive. 
 possibly a new station. 


Tweaks

 Comets will no longer randomly spawn, instead, they will have a countdown timer so you will always know when they'll come to be able to time your trips better. 
 Improved Radiation feedback. 


Fixes

 Oxygen leak on hologates
 Index grip stuff
 Suit radiation bugs 


There's more coming up as well. 


We'll be launching this on test branch early next week (july 30th)
So feel free to try it out and give us some feedback. 

Thanks for playing and thanks for the patience. 


We're also still active on the  STAR SHELTER DISCORD if you wanna have a chat

HAVE FUN!

notes.title: Update # 1.1.8 - Hacking game fix
notes.notes:
At long last
Hey, all. Sorry for the delay in updates. 
we're working hard to still make this game even more awesome. 

Delay reason:
We have another project going to be able to keep us afloat since star shelter alone can't do that, so that has been stealing some of our time. 
we're still very keen on improving the game but it might take a bit longer between updates now. 

FIXES

Salvaged pressurizer reappears on reload 
 nano box storage number wasn't always accurate
 Loss of suit speed upgrades after a restart
 Shields were too small 
 Locker number font too big
 Comets spawn too often later on. 
 upgrading storage space bug
 Salvage things in the space station is now slower
 Inconstant/broken hacking game. 
 Multiple comets were incoming at once during the warnings
 Sleep text on the bed was backward.
 Improved climbing colliders in the space station. 


TWEAKS

 Base nano storage is increased to 75
 Decreased research cancel button size. 
 Suit start storage is reduced to 50
 Increased flashlight range and reduced the radius. 




Things we're working on now:
Grab Issues
We're reworking the grab/interact mechanic system in order to fix the grab issues people are having. it's also going to improve the physics interactions. 

Multiplayer:
While we have to go through all the interactions we're also looking at multiplayer support. 
We're not fully confirming multiplayer yet but it's quite likely now since we had a successful test where we could see each other. We don't have an ETA on that though. 


If you have any bugs make sure to post them here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VfX-2aEa3FVoGg-rvZRkXG8Ay5lB0GAQbwLLCGOV0LQ/edit#gid=264593947

Thanks for playing and thanks for the patience!
HAVE FUN

notes.title: Star shelter Full Release!
notes.notes:
Star shelter is now released after one year of early access! 

THE PAST: 
I just want to thank everyone involved with providing us feedback, and being part of the early access process, it was all crucial to get it to this point. 

THE PRESENT:
Getting the game out of early access just narrows down the possible changes and making it more clear for you as players to see what changes could be reasonable at this point. 

THE FUTURE:
Dont worry, we're not abandoning it, we still have some patches planned ahead and if there's any issues we'll make sure to fix them as soon as possible! 


Thank you so much for playing! 

HAVE FUN!

notes.title: Build # 1.1.7c - Gun mod Hotfix
notes.notes:
The gunmods were broken so we just uploaded a fix for that. 

More updates coming soon.

notes.title: Build # 1.1.1 Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hey, here comes the first bug fix after the big base building Update. 


We have been focusing on the most game breaking bugs so there's not so much new stuff. 

Here's what's fixed so far.


FIXES:

    Storage box objects could randomly disappear. 
    Gates could not be placed or saved properly.
    Salvage mode could get stuck resulting in unwanted salvage.
    Nano storage could randomly loose stuff
    Plants could randomly disappear. 
    Repairing could dismantle the wall/room behind it. 
    No salvage value was displayed for a enegycell object thingy
    Air leak sounds was not fading on distance



Hope this makes the game a bit more enjoyable.


Keep reporting the bugs you find, we're active on our discord channel if you want to know more! 
DISCORD

Thanks for playing   HAVE FUN!
